single.boundary: Bind a single SQL statement against a dialect context, reject semantic errors, and construct the registered final dialect value before returning it.

batch.boundary: Call analyze for each statement against the same supplied context. Rejection prevents publication of the batch.

context.input: An ordered list of SQL relation definitions or null
context.boundary: Build declaration facts from definitions. Reject inputs that do not provide a relation declaration. Null leaves the catalog open and an explicit list can establish a complete catalog. Contexts must belong to the same dialect and language profile.

construction: The dialect value constructors remain public. Binding state is internal and carries no rendered statement. Previously fixed semantic domains, tests, observations, faults and budgets retain their requirements.
